cookie_policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie_policy.description: This page explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage your preferences.
cookie_policy.image_alt: van carrying a cookie box illustration
cookie_policy.manage_note: For more details about personal data processing, see our

paragraphs.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website.
paragraphs.p2: They help the website work correctly, remember your choices (for example language), and can be used for analytics and marketing if you allow it.

paragraphs.p1: We use cookies to keep the website reliable, improve performance, and understand how visitors use the site.
paragraphs.p2: Some cookies are required for core features. Others are optional and are used only if you give consent.

bullets.b1: Remember your settings (for example language and cookie preferences).
bullets.b2: Measure site usage to improve content and user experience.

paragraphs.p1: Different cookies serve different purposes. The exact set may change over time as we improve the website.

bullets.b1: Necessary cookies: required for basic website functionality and security.
bullets.b2: Preference cookies: remember your choices and settings.
bullets.b3: Analytics cookies: help us understand traffic and improve the website (only with consent).
bullets.b4: Marketing cookies: used to measure advertising effectiveness and show relevant ads (only with consent).

paragraphs.p1: We may use third-party tools for analytics and marketing (for example Google services). These providers may set their own cookies.
paragraphs.p2: We enable optional tools only after you give consent (when applicable).

paragraphs.p1: You can control cookies through your browser settings. You can usually delete stored cookies and block new ones.
paragraphs.p2: Blocking some cookies may affect website functionality.

bullets.b1: Browser settings: block, delete, or limit cookies.
bullets.b2: Device settings: control tracking permissions where available.
bullets.b3: Consent choices: change your cookie preferences when you see our cookie notice.

paragraphs.p1: If you have questions about cookies or your privacy, contact us using the Contact page.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.description: This page explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use it, and what rights you have.
privacy_policy.cookies_note: For details about cookies and consent settings, see our

paragraphs.p1: We respect your privacy and process personal data only when it is necessary to provide our services and operate this website.
paragraphs.p2: This policy describes what we process, how long we keep it, who we share it with, and how you can exercise your rights.

paragraphs.p1: We may collect data you provide directly and data generated when you use our website or contact us.
paragraphs.p2: We do not intentionally collect sensitive categories of personal data.

bullets.b1: Contact details: name, phone number, email (when you contact us or request a quote).
bullets.b2: Service details: pickup/location address, requested time window, job notes, items/vehicle details (when relevant).
bullets.b3: Communication history: messages sent via forms, email, phone, or messaging apps.
bullets.b4: Technical data: IP address, device/browser info, and basic usage data (only where permitted and configured).

paragraphs.p1: We use personal data to respond to requests, provide services, and improve the reliability and security of our website.
paragraphs.p2: We use optional analytics/marketing tools only if you provide consent (when applicable).

bullets.b1: Respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
bullets.b2: Prepare and confirm quotes, service terms, and time windows.
bullets.b3: Deliver the requested service and coordinate logistics.
bullets.b4: Protect against abuse, fraud, and security incidents.

paragraphs.p1: We process personal data under the following legal bases (GDPR):

bullets.b1: Contract: to take steps at your request and provide services.
bullets.b2: Legitimate interests: to operate, secure, and improve our website and service processes.
bullets.b3: Consent: for optional cookies/analytics/marketing where required.
bullets.b4: Legal obligation: when accounting or other laws require retention of certain records.

paragraphs.p1: We do not sell personal data.
paragraphs.p2: We may share data only when it is needed to provide services, comply with law, or run the website.

bullets.b1: Service providers: hosting, email, analytics, or messaging providers (only as needed).
bullets.b2: Authorities: when required by law or to protect legal rights.
bullets.b3: Business operations: internal access limited to people who need it to perform their duties.

paragraphs.p1: We keep personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy.
paragraphs.p2: Some records may be retained longer when required by law (for example accounting) or to resolve disputes.

paragraphs.p1: Depending on your situation and applicable law, you may have the following rights:

bullets.b1: Access: request a copy of your personal data.
bullets.b2: Rectification: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
bullets.b3: Erasure: request deletion in certain cases.
bullets.b4: Restriction: limit processing in certain cases.
bullets.b5: Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interests.
bullets.b6: Complaint: lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

paragraphs.p1: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data.
paragraphs.p2: No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, but we work to reduce risk and respond to incidents.

paragraphs.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to make the website work and (optionally) to measure performance and marketing effectiveness.
If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us via the Contact page.
